p0.original: 第一章 心智、行为和心理科学
p0.en: Chapter I: Mental, behavioural and psychological sciences

p1.original: 本章译者：刘明童 傅小兰
p1.en: Translation of this chapter: Liu Ming Boy, Fu Xiaolan

p3.original: 本章视频导读，请扫描二维码观看。
p3.en: Scan the QR code to watch the video introduction to this chapter.

p4.original: 好奇之火不曾熄，人类从未停止过探索自己。《易经》有言：“形而上者谓之道，形而下者谓之器。”人之道——精神、思想、意识，随着时间的洪流发展成现代的一门学科——心理学。那么，心理学究竟是怎样的一门学科呢？本书第一章将向你解答这个问题。
p4.en: The fire of curiosity never went out, and human beings never stopped exploring themselves. The Emancipation says: “The way of what is in shape, the way of what is in shape. The human approach — spirituality, thought, consciousness — has evolved into a modern discipline with the flood of time. So, what kind of a subject is psychology? Chapter I of this book will answer that question.

p5.original: 通过阅读第一章，你将了解心理学是一门研究行为和心理过程的科学，而批判性思维是区分心理学和伪心理学的重要技能；你也会学到心理学的6个主要视角——生物视角、认知视角、行为视角、全人视角、发展视角和社会文化视角，以及这些视角是如何建立并发展起来的。
p5.en: By reading chapter I, you will understand that psychology is a science of behavior and psychological processes, and critical thinking is an important skill in distinguishing between psychology and pseudo-psychology; You will also learn from six main perspectives of psychology — biological, cognitive, behavioural, human, developmental and sociocultural — and how they are built and developed.

p6.original: 除了为你展示心理学的定义和主要视角外，本章还包含心理学研究方法的介绍。在本章中，你将学习如何采用科学的方法研究心理学，并学到五种常用的研究方法，它们分别是实验、相关研究、问卷调查、自然观察和个案研究，而随着对这五种方法的理解逐渐加深，你将知道如何选择最恰当的方法解决不同的心理学问题；你还会得知心理学研究需要规避的偏差——情感偏差、期望偏差和证实性偏差，它们会成为批判性思考之路上的绊脚石，甚至会对研究结果产生不利影响。本章也会为你展示心理学研究中可能涉及的严肃伦理问题，以及相应的伦理规则，比如，需要获取被试的知情同意，如果对被试使用了任何欺骗手段就必须尽快提供事后解释等。
p6.en: In addition to presenting you with the definition and main perspective of psychology, this chapter also includes an introduction to psychological research methods. In this chapter, you will learn how to use scientific methods to study psychology and learn about five common research methods, namely, experiments, related studies, questionnaires, natural observations and case studies, and, as the understanding of these five methods deepens, you will know how to choose the most appropriate way to solve different psychological problems; You will also learn about the deviations that psychological research needs to avoid — emotional deviations, expectations deviations and corroborative deviations — which can be a stumbling block in the way of critical thinking, and may even have a negative impact on the results of research. This chapter will also show you the serious ethical issues that may be involved in psychological research, as well as the corresponding ethical rules, such as the need to obtain informed consent to be tested, and the need to provide ex post facto explanations as soon as any means of deception are used.

p7.original: 心理学正处于快速发展期，其突出特点表现为：
p7.en: The psychology is developing rapidly, with the following salient features:

p8.original: 1. 心理学与神经生物学、医学、信息科学、工程学等学科高度交叉融合，采用基因分析、现代神经影像等技术，从基因—脑—行为—认知的角度，分层次研究人脑认知功能、情绪情感过程及其神经机制，不断深化对心理活动物质基础的认识，同时也在促进人工智能发展；
p8.en: The high degree of cross-fertilization of psychology with subjects such as neurobiology, medicine, information science, engineering, using techniques such as genetic analysis, modern neuroimages, and a hierarchical study of human brain cognitive functions, emotional processes and their nervous mechanisms from a genetic-brain-behavioural-cognitive perspective, which is constantly deepening the understanding of the material basis of psychological activity and also promoting the development of artificial intelligence;

p9.original: 2. 心理学积极应对网络化、信息化和全球化带来的新问题和新挑战，开展基于新媒体、大数据分析的宏观社会心理规律研究，注重阐明人类个体与社会行为的心理机制，以理解、调节并提高人的社会行为效率，促进社会和谐发展；
p9.en: 2. Psychological response to new problems and challenges arising from networking, informatization and globalization by conducting macro-psychological studies based on new media, big data analysis, focusing on the psychological mechanisms of individual and social human behaviour in order to understand, regulate and improve the efficiency of human social behaviour and promote harmonious social development;

p10.original: 3. 心理学努力为解决各种心理和行为问题以及认知和情绪障碍提供理论基础、方法和技术，对心理疾患进行早期识别和干预，“生理—心理—社会—工程”的新医学模式和人类身心健康促进模式日益被理解和接受。
p10.en: Psychological efforts have provided the theoretical basis, methods and techniques for addressing psychological and behavioural problems and cognitive and emotional disorders, early identification and intervention in mental disorders, and new medical models of “physico-psychological-social-engineering” and models for the promotion of human physical and mental health are increasingly understood and accepted.

p11.original: 希望在阅读完本章后，你对心理学这门学科的认识和理解能更加深入，知其可为与不可为，更好地运用心理学知识丰富你的生活；希望现在或未来的心理学从业者能够掌握且熟练运用心理学的科学研究方法，严谨治学，勇于创新，科学地开展心理学研究，为心理学学科建设添砖加瓦。
p11.en: It is hoped that after reading this chapter you will be able to gain a deeper knowledge and understanding of the subject of psychology and know its potential to be effective and better utilize your knowledge of psychology to enrich your life; It is hoped that current or future psychologists will be able to master and be skilled in the use of psychological science methods, be disciplined, be innovative, conduct psychological research scientifically and build bricks for the psychological sciences.

p12.original: 那么现在，让我们一起来领略心理学的魅力吧！
p12.en: Now, let's get some psychological charm!
